territories.name: Nepal
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Nepal levies a value-added tax of its own under the Value-Added Tax Act, 2052 (1996): section 7 sets it at a flat thirteen percent and a zero rate for the transactions of Schedule 2, section 5(3) exempts those of Schedule 1, and section 18 has the taxpayer file the return within twenty-five days of the completion of each month.
